extracted.intended_audience: Recipients of NEH Fellowships, Summer Stipends, and Faculty Research Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing and submitting an NEH performance report describing what was accomplished during the award tenure, differences from the original plan, impacts on scholarship and teaching, time and location breakdown, institutional support, and any deviations in tenure or effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work performed vs. planned
rubrics_metrics.description: What did you do during the tenure of your award, and how does this compare with what you had planned to do when you applied?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain actual activities during the award period and explicitly compare them to the original project plan submitted with the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change in understanding or approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Has either your understanding of your subject or your approach to it changed significantly as a result of the work conducted under your award? If so, in what way?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe substantive shifts in research questions, methods, interpretations, or theoretical framing that resulted from the award-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact on scholarly career
rubrics_metrics.description: How has your award-supported work furthered your scholarly career?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain ways the project advanced your professional development, visibility, or future research directions (e.g., new opportunities, collaborations, promotions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication plans
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify intended publications, formats, timelines, and venues that will result from the award-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implications for teaching / course contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Does your award-supported work have implications for your teaching? Please provide titles if your research will contribute to new or revised courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether and how the research will inform courses, list proposed course titles, and indicate new or revised curricula stemming from the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to continue project work
rubrics_metrics.description: To what extent will you be able to continue work on the project supported by the award?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate plans and feasibility for continuing the research after the award, including time, resources, and next steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assistance from employer or other sources
rubrics_metrics.description: What assistance, if any, will you receive for this from your employer or from other sources (including released time, research or secretarial assistance, etc., as well as award assistance?)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List types and amounts of support (released time, staff, facilities, funding) provided by employer or other sources to continue the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty Research Award — institutional educational mission impact
rubrics_metrics.description: For Faculty Research Award recipients: are there other ways in which your award-supported work will further the educational mission of your institution?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe additional institutional benefits (e.g., curricular development, student training, public programming) resulting from the Faculty Research Award project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time/location breakdown during fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: Expressed roughly in percentages, what proportion of the fellowship period did you spend (a) at your own institution or home? (b) at other locations in the U.S.? (c) at locations abroad? Please specify the other locations, if any.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide approximate percentage allocation of fellowship time across listed location categories and name any specific other locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer additional financial contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Did your employer contribute any additional funds for travel, supplies, research assistance, or other such ancillary purpose, to help you with your work under the fellowship? If so, please indicate amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report any monetary contributions from employer for project-related expenses and state the amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sabbatical or leave policy
rubrics_metrics.description: What is the sabbatical or similar leave policy at your place of employment?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize institutional policies governing sabbaticals or equivalent leaves that relate to your ability to undertake the award-supported work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award tenure begin and end dates
rubrics_metrics.description: When did you begin and end your award tenure?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide exact start and end dates for the period during which you used the award resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repayment if tenure shorter than awarded
rubrics_metrics.description: If the length of your actual tenure was shorter than that specified in the official notice of action that accompanied the NEH award letter, the Endowment will request, on a pro rata basis, appropriate repayment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If actual tenure is shorter than awarded, expect NEH to seek prorated repayment; report any deviations and be aware of repayment implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty Research Award — explanation of differing effort
rubrics_metrics.description: For Faculty Research Award recipients: If the total amount of full or half time spent on your project during your award tenure differed from that indicated in your acceptance form, describe and explain the difference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If actual full/half-time effort differed from what was accepted, explain magnitude and reasons for the difference.
